q: Why does the verifier compare our purchase ledger with the fuel in our emissions report?
title: Purchase ledger checks for missing fuel
short: It is a completeness test. The verifier looks for fuel, gas, refrigerant or power bought during the year that never reached the inventory. Every fuel ledger entry should match a line in your workings, or carry a reason, such as stock carried forward or fuel resold.
audience: Accounts and plant teams preparing for verification

ul: Diesel bought in cash or through petty cash.

p: Ledger quantity, opening and closing stock, quantity in the inventory, difference and reason.

ul: Fuel bought by a sister unit.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure tied to its invoice, factor and method version, so a verifier can trace any number back to the document it came from.

sources.label: ISO 14064-3, verification of greenhouse gas statements
